record.context_brief: Brouwer-type fixed points for VMO maps
record.original_question: Let B be the closed unit ball in R^N and let f:B→B be a VMO map. Must it be true that for every ε>0 the approximate fixed-point set {x∈B: |f(x)-x|<ε} has positive measure?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 5.10. Let B be the closed unit ball in RN and let f be a VMO map from B into itself. Is it true that for every ε > 0, the set {x ∈ B : |f(x) − x| < ε} has positive measure?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $N\ge 1$ and let $B\subset\mathbb{R}^N$ denote the closed unit ball. Recall that a measurable map $f:B\to\mathbb{R}^N$ is said to have vanishing mean oscillation (VMO) on $B$ if
$$\lim_{r\to 0}\;\sup_{x\in B,\;0<\rho<r}\;\frac{1}{|B(x,\rho)\cap B|}\int_{B(x,\rho)\cap B}\bigl|f(y)-\overline{f}_{B(x,\rho)\cap B}\bigr|\,dy \;=\;0,$$
where $\overline{f}_{E}$ denotes the average of $f$ on a measurable set $E$ of positive Lebesgue measure. Suppose $f:B\to B$ is a VMO map (i.e., $f$ takes values in $B$ almost everywhere and is VMO as a map into $\mathbb{R}^N$).

Question: Is it true that for every $\varepsilon>0$, the approximate fixed-point set
$$\{x\in B:\ |f(x)-x|<\varepsilon\}$$
has positive Lebesgue measure?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem in a recent collection of favorite open problems. While degree theory for VMO maps has been developed (e.g., by Brezis–Nirenberg and later authors) and yields some Brouwer-type results, no resolution of this specific approximate-fixed-point measure statement was found in the search.

status_evidence.title: Degree Theory for VMO Maps on Metric Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Develops degree theory for VMO maps and Brouwer-type fixed point results for VMO self-maps of the disk.
status_evidence.claim: Existing literature treats degree/fixed-point theory for VMO maps but does not appear to resolve the measure question for approximate fixed-point sets.
